notes: Prompt author (generative), not a critic. Grade the SHAPE of the emitted prompt (does it fill the archetype's slots for an agentic session) AND the discipline: it must shape, never run the task; it must name a routing archetype, never a model string; and it must compose (call model-recommender for the tier, prompt-audit as the final gate). Cases 1-3 are archetype matches; case 4 is a no-fit control (must not force a wrong archetype); case 5 is a don't-run-the-task control; case 6 exercises the growth-loop capture dependency. Archetype ids are those in references/prompt-archetypes.md as of 2026-07-05.

evals.name: flagship-context-anchored-planning
evals.prompt: /smart-prompt read refs/README.md and study gsd-core and obra/superpowers cloned in this refs directory to know how they gather context to anchor an implementation (plan -> implementation plan)
assertions: Matches archetype context-anchored-planning; routes deliberation tier (gather phase recon/low, plan phase deliberation/high) via model-recommender
Emitted prompt is read-only-first, requires citing anchors (file:line) from both projects, and has an explicit plan-not-code output contract
Adds a clarify-first gate for the ambiguity the loose intent left implicit
Does NOT itself read the repos and produce the plan — it emits a prompt to do so
Ends with the capture offer; names no concrete model string

evals.name: cartography-recon-readonly
evals.prompt: /smart-prompt help me understand how auth flows through this service
assertions: Matches codebase-cartography; routes recon tier, effort low
Emitted prompt is read-only with a structured-map output contract (entry points, flow, key files) and a stop-at-the-map stop condition
Does not add an implementation or refactor step

evals.name: scoped-implementation-with-verification
evals.prompt: /smart-prompt add null-guards to the parse* functions in parsers/ that lack one; it's done when npm test passes
assertions: Matches scoped-implementation; routes execution tier
Emitted prompt has tight scope (parsers/, parse* only), an acceptance condition, and the verification command `npm test` exits 0
Keeps altitude at outcomes (guard the functions) rather than scripting each edit

evals.name: no-archetype-fit-control
evals.prompt: /smart-prompt draft a friendly release announcement for the 2.0 launch and post it to the changelog
assertions: No catalog archetype fits cleanly; shapes from the universal slots directly rather than forcing a wrong archetype
Marks it a candidate shape (candidate:<name>) for the ledger, not a validated archetype
Still produces a well-formed prompt (objective, output contract, acceptance) and offers capture

evals.name: shape-not-run-control
evals.prompt: /smart-prompt just fix the flaky test in test/checkout.spec.ts
assertions: Recognizes this as an intent to shape, not a command to execute; does NOT edit the test or run the suite itself
Emits an investigation-diagnosis-shaped prompt (reproduce the flake, isolate the cause, confirm, then fix) rather than a blind fix
The emitted prompt carries a verification and a clarify-first for the unknown (what 'flaky' means here)

evals.name: growth-loop-capture-dependency
evals.prompt: That shaped prompt worked great, the plan was exactly right - save it.
assertions: Loads references/growth-loop.md and appends a sanitized entry to ~/.claude/smart-prompt-ledger.md (creating it if missing)
Sanitizes first: strips any secrets/internal hostnames and minimizes personal data before writing
Does NOT write into the plugin (public repo) and does NOT auto-promote to the catalog — promotion is human-gated
